tokens.v: The product configurator, PCF, builds variants from a generic item. Features and their options are what a customer chooses. Constraints are small programs: validation constraints refuse a combination or decide whether a BOM line applies, and parameter substitution constraints build the variant's item code, description and price. The generic BOM and routing carry every possible line, each line kept or dropped by its constraint.
